inclusion_rule: Lip reading or visual/audio-visual speech recognition whose visual input is an event stream, recorded by an event camera (DVS/DAVIS/Prophesee) or converted from RGB video. Boundary: event cameras used for non-speech face tasks (action units, gait) are excluded; event datasets without a recognition result count only if they report one; versions of one study count once.
